notes.subject: maielĩ
notes.rationale: אילים: 'oaks' (KJV/ASV) vs 'terebinths' (JPS) vs 'idols' (Wycliffe, metonymy for worship under sacred trees).

notes.subject: honjoka / ihũriruo
notes.rationale: יבשו is literally 'dry up/wither', תחפרו 'blush'; both rendered by Gĩkũyũ shame-words, losing the withering image that links to verse 30.

notes.subject: חמדתם/בחרתם
notes.rationale: Parallel pair 'desired/chosen' with repeated אשר structure — the chiastic symmetry of shame matched to object is kept but the sound-pair is lost.

notes.subject: arĩa mwerethire / arĩa mĩathire
notes.rationale: Relative clauses fronted for clarity; Hebrew word order places the verb after the noun.

translation: Nĩgũkorwo nĩmahonjoka nĩ ⟨arĩa mwerethire⟩ maielĩ, na maihũriruo nĩ ⟨arĩa mĩathire⟩ marũithĩro.
